The Divine Sound of Navratri

WHERE SHAKTI MEETS CELEBRATION

A new cultural chapter built around tradition, movement, craftsmanship, music and community.

The Divine Sound of Navratri

Where Shakti Meets Celebration

Shakti Chakra is imagined as a grand, soulful Navratri celebration — a place where the energy of Maa Shakti meets the timeless rhythm of Gujarati Garba.

Come in your finest traditional attire, gather your people and step into an atmosphere built around music, devotion, movement and unforgettable memories.

“The circle of Garba is more than a dance. It is a celebration of energy, togetherness and life.”
Discover the Experience →
THE POWER WITHIN

Nine Qualities. One Shakti.

Inspired by the values that make Navratri more than a festival — faith, wisdom, courage, joy, strength, prosperity, unity, service and compassion.

01 · SHRADDHA

શ્રદ્ધા

Faith

The light that gives belief, direction and strength.

02 · GYAN

જ્ઞાન

Wisdom

The clarity that guides thought, choices and destiny.

03 · DHAIRYA

ધૈર્ય

Courage & Patience

Standing firm and turning challenges into strength.

04 · ANAND

આનંદ

Joy

Celebrating life with gratitude and beautiful memories.

05 · SHAKTI

શક્તિ

Strength

The power to rise, protect, create and overcome.

06 · SAMRUDDHI

સમૃદ્ધિ

Prosperity

A life that flourishes through abundance and togetherness.

07 · EKTA

એકતા

Unity

Thousands of hearts moving together in one rhythm.

08 · SEVA

સેવા

Selfless Service

Giving with an open heart and celebrating community.

09 · KARUNA

કરુણા

Compassion

Kindness that connects one person to another.

A New Navratri Chapter

The Story Behind Shakti Chakra

Shakti Chakra is built around one simple idea: let the spiritual meaning of Navratri and the electricity of Garba live in the same circle. The result is a celebration designed to feel rooted, contemporary and deeply Ahmedabad.

01 · ROOTS

Tradition, With Intention

From the first diya to the final dandiya beat, every moment can carry the warmth of Gujarati culture without feeling like a museum piece.

02 · RHYTHM

Music That Moves the Circle

Garba is a shared rhythm. Shakti Chakra brings together live energy, percussion, vocals and a dance floor designed for collective celebration.

03 · CONNECTION

Come as a Crowd, Leave as a Circle

Friends, families, couples, college groups and first-time khelaiyas all have a place here. The celebration grows when everyone belongs.

Beyond The Dance

The Shakti Chakra Code

Five ideas guide the experience — inspired by the spirit of Navratri, but expressed in our own voice.

ॐ

Devotion

Begin with gratitude. Celebrate the divine energy behind the festival.

◉

Movement

Let every circle, clap and step become part of one living rhythm.

✦

Belonging

Make space for every generation, every group and every first-time dancer.

❖

Craft

Celebrate Gujarati colour, costume, music, food and artistry with modern presentation.

∞

Memory

Create the kind of moments that stay long after the last song ends.

The Shakti Chakra Manifesto

Not just a night out. A feeling you carry home.

We believe the best Navratri memories are made when music feels alive, tradition feels personal, and the people around you become part of the story. Shakti Chakra is our invitation to celebrate with energy, grace and heart.
